See [Schema files: Compare with `diff`](/schema-files#compare-with-diff).

```text
Show what applying a schema file would change, without changing anything

Usage: tachyon schema diff [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>  

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>   Config file. Every setting can also come from a TACHYON_* environment variable [default: tachyon.toml]
      --rename <RENAMES>  Rename a field instead of removing it and adding a new one: collection:field=new_name
  -h, --help              Print help
```
